    rw [h_re_eq]
    rw [Complex.re_sum]

    intro i
    have h_re_le : (z^(i + 1 : ℕ)).re ≤ ‖z^(i + 1 : ℕ)‖ := le_trans (le_abs_self _) (Complex.abs_re_le_norm _)

      apply pow_le_one₀

    linarith

    rw [← h_re]
    ring

    intro i
    linarith [h_le i]

    rw [Fintype.sum_eq_zero_iff_of_nonneg] at h_sum_one_sub
    · exact congr_fun h_sum_one_sub
    · exact h_nonneg

    have h_zero : 1 - (z^(0 + 1 : ℕ)).re = 0 := by

    simp only [zero_add, pow_one] at h_zero
    linarith

    have h1 : |z.re| = 1 := by rw [h_z_re, abs_one]
    have h2 : |z.re| ≤ ‖z‖ := Complex.abs_re_le_norm z
    have h3 : ‖z‖ = 1 := by linarith
    have h4 : |z.re| = ‖z‖ := by linarith
    have h5 : z.im = 0 := by
      rw [Complex.abs_re_eq_norm] at h4
      exact h4
    rw [Complex.ext_iff]
    simp [h_z_re, h5]

    intro i

    intro i
    have : (i : ℕ) < n := i.isLt
    have : (i : ℝ) < n := by exact_mod_cast this
    linarith

    apply Finset.sum_pos
    · intro i _
      exact h_pos i
    · use ⟨0, hn⟩
      exact Finset.mem_univ _
  linarith

lemma sum_recurrence (d : ℕ) (z : ℂ) : (∑ i : Fin (d+1), ((d + 1 - (i : ℕ)) : ℂ) * z^(i : ℕ)) = (d + 1 : ℂ) + z * ∑ i : Fin d, ((d - (i : ℕ)) : ℂ) * z^(i : ℕ) := by
  rw [Fin.sum_univ_succ]
  simp only [Fin.val_zero, Nat.cast_zero, sub_zero, pow_zero, mul_one]
  have h : ∀ i : Fin d, (((d + 1 - (i.succ : ℕ)) : ℂ) * z^(i.succ : ℕ)) = z * (((d - (i : ℕ)) : ℂ) * z^(i : ℕ)) := by
    intro i
    rw [Fin.val_succ]
    push_cast
    ring
  simp_rw [h]
  rw [← Finset.mul_sum]

lemma sum_z_pow_new (d : ℕ) (z : ℂ) : (∑ i : Fin (d+1), z^(i + 1 : ℕ)) = z + ∑ i : Fin d, z^(i + 2 : ℕ) := by
  rw [Fin.sum_univ_succ]
  simp only [Fin.val_zero, zero_add, pow_one]
  congr 2

lemma helper_identity (n : ℕ) (z : ℂ) : (1 - z) * (∑ i : Fin n, ((n - (i : ℕ)) : ℂ) * z^(i : ℕ)) = (n : ℂ) - ∑ i : Fin n, z^(i + 1 : ℕ) := by
  induction' n with d hd
  · simp
  · simp only [Nat.cast_succ]
    rw [sum_recurrence]
    have h1 : (1 - z) * ((d + 1 : ℂ) + z * ∑ i : Fin d, ((d - (i : ℕ)) : ℂ) * z^(i : ℕ)) =
      (1 - z) * (d + 1 : ℂ) + z * ((1 - z) * ∑ i : Fin d, ((d - (i : ℕ)) : ℂ) * z^(i : ℕ)) := by ring
    rw [h1, hd]
    rw [sum_z_pow_new]
    have h2 : (∑ i : Fin d, z^(i + 2 : ℕ)) = z * ∑ i : Fin d, z^(i + 1 : ℕ) := by
      have h3 : ∀ i : Fin d, z^(i + 2 : ℕ) = z * z^(i + 1 : ℕ) := by
        intro i
        ring
      simp_rw [h3]
      rw [← Finset.mul_sum]
    rw [h2]
    ring

- `∏ x, f x` is notation for `Finset.prod Finset.univ f`. It is the product of `f x`,
  where `x` ranges over the finite domain of `f`.
- `∏ x ∈ s, f x` is notation for `Finset.prod s f`. It is the product of `f x`,
  where `x` ranges over the finite set `s` (either a `Finset` or a `Set` with a `Fintype` instance).
- `∏ x ∈ s with p x, f x` is notation for `Finset.prod (Finset.filter p s) f`.
- `∏ x ∈ s with h : p x, f x h` is notation for
  `Finset.prod s fun x ↦ if h : p x then f x h else 1`.
- `∏ (x ∈ s) (y ∈ t), f x y` is notation for `Finset.prod (s ×ˢ t) (fun ⟨x, y⟩ ↦ f x y)`.

These support destructuring, for example `∏ ⟨x, y⟩ ∈ s ×ˢ t, f x y`.
